name: Apps
description: Produces a complete small web app from one request — chat tool, directory, to-do list, game — shipped as Vite, React and TypeScript against a Convex backend. The stack is fixed, so it suits starting something new rather than extending code you already have.

official.title: Apps by Wayne
official.description: Builds one-shot web apps on Convex. Ask it to build a chat app, directory, todo, or game and it ships Vite + React + TypeScript with a Convex backend...
